description: Render a voiceover from a script via text-to-speech. Returns an audioId — pass it to pedra_create_video / pedra_update_video as voice.audioId to attach the narration (with synced subtitles).

language.description: Voice language, e.g. "English", "Español". Defaults to English.

voiceId.description: Which voice narrates. Call pedra_music_library for the voices offered per language — a voice is only valid for the language it is listed under. Defaults to that language's first voice.

name: pedra_generate_voice
title: Generate voiceover audio
